next_evidence.matrix: Four matched fresh-cluster pairs on one frozen source: current zero-effective status interval versus a positive whole-second interval.
next_evidence.interpretation: A difference must distinguish local progress from reporting delay before attributing either historical deadline. No production bound, assertion or profile change; stop inconclusive if the discriminating condition is absent.

limits: Eight passing cases do not refute an intermittent deadline.
Both source cohorts have identical operational bytes, not independent runtime versions.
Focused serial port25500 cases do not replay the original whole concurrent port25900 iteration.
Machine endpoint readings and four owned CPU workers do not establish or exclude shared-host scheduling or I/O effects.
The retained primary-reported prefix does not show simultaneous standby-local progress.
No zero-versus-positive live comparison was run; parser results alone do not prove historical causation.
The historical full failed command streams were not retained separately; the diagnostic trace and harness error were retained.
No code, bound, check, conformance status or accepted policy is changed.
